_example._exampleNote: Placeholder example. Fill from a real, cited book: every bookTitle/author/volume/page must be verifiable. summary/fullText must be written from the actual source, never generated from memory.

_note: VERIFICATION POLICY: tafsir summaries and full texts may ONLY be written from the cited book in hand (bookTitle/author/volume/page must be exact). Rows missing a resolvable verse or with placeholder "…" summaries are rejected by scripts/seed-sample-tafsirs.ts. New content should enter as status "draft" and move through the admin review workflow.

_schema.author: book author (required)
_schema.fullText: extended excerpt/summary from the book (optional; required before publishing)
_schema.language: language of the summary text, e.g. bengali (optional, default bengali)
_schema.page: page number(s) within the volume (optional but required before publishing)
_schema.sourceUrl: link to a legitimate online edition if available (optional)
_schema.status: draft | review | published — always seed as "draft" (optional, default draft)
_schema.summary: Bengali summary of what this book says about the verse (required). Placeholder "…" is rejected.
_schema.verifiedBy: name of the person who verified the citation (optional)
_schema.verse: { surahNumber, ayahNumber } convenience lookup — resolved to the Verse _id at seed time (required unless verseId is given)
_schema.verseId: Verse document _id as a string (alternative to "verse")
_schema.volume: volume number of the book (optional but required before publishing)
